scripts.title: Cupid Dungeon Lava Curse ESP
scripts.script:
if game.PlaceId ~= 11424731604 then
    return
end

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local Effects = Workspace:WaitForChild("Effects", 9e9)

local function Setup(Child)
    local TextDrawing = Drawing.new("Text")

    TextDrawing.Text = "Lava Curse"
    TextDrawing.Size = 14
    TextDrawing.Font = 3
    TextDrawing.Center = true
    TextDrawing.Outline = true
    TextDrawing.OutlineColor = Color3.new()
    TextDrawing.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    TextDrawing.Visible = false

    local Connection = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
        local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Child.WorldPivot.Position)

        if Visible then
            TextDrawing.Position = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
            TextDrawing.Visible = true
        else
            TextDrawing.Visible = false
        end
    end)

    Child.Destroying:Connect(function()
        Connection:Disconnect()
        TextDrawing:Destroy()
    end)
end

local Connection; Connection = Effects.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child)
    if Child.Name == "Lava Curse" then
        Setup(Child)
        Connection:Disconnect()
    end
end)

local LavaCurse = Effects:FindFirstChild("Lava Curse")

if LavaCurse then
    Setup(LavaCurse)
    Connection:Disconnect()
end
